title: Read planning records at a revision
responsibility: Reads stored plans and converts their versions, messages, images and history for the desktop.

inputs.name: planningReads.context
inputs.description: The repository root and planning API used by this read. The root supplies Git reads for prompt and notes text, while the API supplies planning snapshots and entity data.

inputs.name: planningReads.revision
inputs.description: The revision passed to the planning API for the snapshot and to Git reads for prompt and notes text.

inputs.name: readPlanMessages.context
inputs.description: The repository root and planning API used by this read. The root supplies Git reads for prompt and notes text, while the API supplies planning snapshots and entity data.

inputs.name: readPlanMessages.data
inputs.type: { entityId: string; threadId: string; revision: string }
inputs.description: The entity unit ID, thread ID, and revision passed to readPlan; messages are returned only if that thread belongs to the entity.

inputs.name: readPlanImage.context
inputs.description: The repository root and planning API used by this read. The root supplies Git reads for prompt and notes text, while the API supplies planning snapshots and entity data.

inputs.name: readPlanImage.query
inputs.description: The entity unit ID, version, image SHA-256, and revision identifying the image; an option, when supplied, is forwarded to the image read. The image must be present in the requested entity and version.

inputs.name: readPlanHistory.context
inputs.description: The repository root and planning API used by this read. The root supplies Git reads for prompt and notes text, while the API supplies planning snapshots and entity data.

inputs.name: readPlanHistory.entityId
inputs.description: The unit ID whose planning commit history is requested.

inputs.name: readPlanHistory.revision
inputs.description: The revision passed to the planning API to limit the entity history.

inputs.name: planRecord.context
inputs.description: The planning context whose repository root is used to read each version's prompt and optional notes from Git.

inputs.name: planRecord.plan
inputs.description: The stored plan detail being converted to a desktop record, including its identity, contract, versions, approvals, and threads.

examples.title: Evidence Grid
examples.goal: Show review evidence in a compact grid.

inputs.name: planRecord.revision
inputs.description: The Git revision from which each version's prompt and optional notes are read.

inputs.name: planVersion.context
inputs.description: The planning context whose repository root is used to read the version prompt and optional notes from Git.

inputs.name: planVersion.data
inputs.type: { version: StoredVersion; plan: PlanDetail; revision: string }
inputs.description: The stored version, its containing plan, and the revision used for Git text reads; the plan supplies matching approvals and the version supplies prompt, image, and option metadata.

plan.title: Evidence Grid
plan.goal: Show review evidence in a compact grid.

outputs.name: planningReads
outputs.description: Resolves to one converted PlanRecord for each plan in the snapshot at the requested revision. A nonempty rejected list throws an Error containing the rejected paths and messages; API or Git read failures also reject.

outputs.name: planRecord
outputs.description: Resolves to a desktop PlanRecord with the category pluralized and its contract, versions, and threads converted. Version prompts and optional notes are read from Git at the requested revision.

examples.title: Evidence Grid
examples.goal: Show review evidence in a compact grid.

outputs.name: planVersion
outputs.description: Resolves to a desktop DesignVersion with prompt and optional notes read from Git, converted image and option metadata, and the last approval matching this version or null. A revision binding is included only when the stored version revises an earlier image.

outputs.name: readPlanMessages
outputs.description: Resolves to the selected thread's messages converted to desktop ThreadMessage records. The requested thread must belong to the entity at the requested revision.

outputs.name: readPlanImage
outputs.description: Resolves to the image bytes returned by readImage after the image is found in the requested entity and version. The optional design option is forwarded to readImage.

outputs.name: readPlanHistory
outputs.type: Promise<{ id: string; at: string; kind: "commit"; title: string; detail: string; commit: string; version: null; }[]>
outputs.description: Resolves to history entries mapped from commits, with event kinds joined into detail and version set to null. The returned entry ID and commit are the same commit identifier.

errors.name: Rejected plan, missing thread, or missing image
errors.description: An Error is thrown when a snapshot contains rejected plans, a requested thread is missing, or an image is absent from its entity/version. Planning API and Git prompt/notes read failures also reject the corresponding operation.

outputs.name: planningReads
outputs.description: Resolves to one converted PlanRecord for each plan in the snapshot at the requested revision. A nonempty rejected list throws an Error containing the rejected paths and messages; API or Git read failures also reject.

errors.name: Invalid planning snapshot or metadata read failure
errors.description: Throws an Error containing rejected plan paths and messages when the snapshot reports rejected entries; planning API, conversion, or Git text reads may also reject.

outputs.name: readPlanMessages
outputs.description: Resolves to the selected thread's messages converted to desktop ThreadMessage records. The requested thread must belong to the entity at the requested revision.

errors.name: Missing planning thread or plan read failure
errors.description: Throws an Error when the requested thread is not found on the entity; the planning API read may also reject.

inputs.name: readPlanImage.context

outputs.description: Resolves to the image bytes returned by readImage after the image is found in the requested entity and version. The optional design option is forwarded to readImage.

errors.name: Missing version image or plan read failure
errors.description: Throws an Error when the requested version contains no image with the requested SHA-256; planning API reads may also reject.

inputs.name: readPlanHistory.context

inputs.name: readPlanHistory.revision

outputs.description: Resolves to history entries mapped from commits, with event kinds joined into detail and version set to null. The returned entry ID and commit are the same commit identifier.

errors.name: Planning history read failure
errors.description: Rejects if the planning API's entityHistory read fails.
